I'm building a reusable job-search skill for a candidate based in Venice, Italy with an EU long-term residence permit, hunting REMOTE-first roles across Europe (AI/automation engineer, solutions/forward-deployed engineer, full-stack dev, technical PM). I need to know which job boards are actually usable with the WebSearch and WebFetch tools in this environment.

Use ONLY WebSearch and WebFetch. Do NOT use curl, wget, python requests, or any bash-based fetching — prohibited here. If a domain is blocked or fails, record that and move on. Don't retry a blocked domain more than once.

Test these boards for (a) whether WebFetch can load a listings/search page, and (b) whether the page yields structured job info (title, company, location, remote policy, salary, link):

Tier 1 (test all): himalayas.app, weworkremotely.com, remoteok.com, euremotejobs.com, jobs.eu / eures (europa.eu EURES portal), landing.jobs, wellfound.com, workatastartup.com, aijobs.net, remoterocketship.com, jobicy.com, welcometothejungle.com, arbeitnow.com
Tier 2 (only if time permits): otta.com, nofluffjobs.com, wearedevelopers.com, honeypot.io, linkedin.com/jobs, indeed.com, glassdoor.com

For the ones that load, figure out whether URL query parameters work for filtering — e.g. can you hit a search URL with a keyword + "remote" + region filter directly and get relevant results? Give verbatim working URL templates where you find them (e.g. https://himalayas.app/jobs/... with params).

Also check: do any of these boards have a plain-text or JSON endpoint that WebFetch renders cleanly (some boards expose /api or RSS feeds that come through as readable text)? Test at most 3 such candidates via WebFetch only.

Return a concise, factual report:
- Table-style rundown: board → fetchable? → quality of extractable data → verbatim working URL template(s)
- Which boards are blocked or useless, with the specific failure mode
- Your top 4-5 recommended sources for EU-remote tech roles, with reasoning
- Any freshness signals available (posting dates visible? can you filter to last 7/30 days?)

Every claim must be backed by a call you actually made. Aim for ~25 tool calls max.

Every row below is backed by a call I made. ## Board rundown | Board | Fetchable? | Data quality | Verbatim working template | |---|---|---|---| | **euremotejobs.com** | Yes | **Best overall.** Title, company, region ("Europe", "EMEA, Poland, Portugal, Spain"), seniority, category, posting age to the minute. Salary on ~30% (`£82,700 annually`, `€105,000 - €125,000 EUR / year`). 124 pages on Europe region. | `https://euremotejobs.com/job-region/remote-jobs-europe/`
`https://euremotejobs.com/job-region/{spain,portugal,germany,ireland,uk}/`

`https://euremotejobs.com/jobs/remote-data-jobs/` · `/jobs/all-remote-jobs/` | | **remoterocketship.com** | Yes | **Best for Italy/EU targeting.** Title, company, country, salary in local currency (`€35k-€45k/yr`, `€6k-€6.5k/month`, `$80-$110/hr`), seniority, dates to the minute. | `https://www.remoterocketship.com/country/italy?page=1&sort=DateAdded&jobTitle=AI%20Engineer`
`https://www.remoterocketship.com/?page=1&sort=DateAdded&locations=Europe` | | **himalayas.app** | Yes (rate-limits) | Title, company, **explicit region restriction** ("United Kingdom only", "Netherlands only", "Global", "Multiple (AL, AD + 71)"), relative dates. Salary rarely shown. | `https://himalayas.app/jobs`
`https://himalayas.app/jobs/countries/italy` (117 pages)
`https://himalayas.app/jobs/python` (8 pages) · `/jobs/engineering`
`?page=N` for pagination | | **arbeitnow.com** | Yes — **JSON** | Clean JSON: `slug, company_name, title, description, remote, url, tags, job_types, location, created_at` (epoch). Germany/DACH-heavy, mixed non-tech. | `https://arbeitnow.com/api/job-board-api` | | **remoteok.com** | API only | HTML page = JS shell, zero listings. `/api` returns valid JSON: `position, company, location, tags, date, epoch, apply_url, url, salary_min, salary_max`. **Caveat: every `salary_min/max` I saw was `$0`**, tags are noisy, feed is global/non-tech-heavy. | `https://remoteok.com/api` | | **aijobs.net** | Yes | Title, location, **salary in EUR on nearly every row** (`EUR 60K–74K`, `EUR 65K–84K`), age in hours. 46,899 results. Company names weren't extracted. No URL params discoverable from the page. | `https://aijobs.net/` (params undocumented on page — unverified) | | **wellfound.com** | Yes | Title, company, salary band, direct `/jobs/{id}-{slug}` links, 1,808 results / 45 pages. **US-dominated**, no posting dates. | `https://wellfound.com/role/r/software-engineer` | ## Blocked or useless | Board | Failure mode | |---|---| | weworkremotely.com | Returns `[binary data]` — unparseable. Both `/categories/remote-programming-jobs` and the `.rss` feed. Dead. | | welcometothejungle.com | `ROBOTS_DISALLOWED` | | landing.jobs | `ROBOTS_DISALLOWED` | | jobicy.com | `ROBOTS_DISALLOWED` (incl. the `/api/v2/remote-jobs` endpoint) | | linkedin.com/jobs | `ROBOTS_DISALLOWED` | | nofluffjobs.com | `PROXY_REJECTED` (HTTP 403) | | EURES (europa.eu/eures/portal/jv-se/search) | Loads, renders only `Loading...`. JS single-page app, no server-rendered content. Dead. | | jobs.eu | `robots.txt fetch failed: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] Hostname mismatch, certificate is not valid for 'jobs.eu'`. Dead. | | workatastartup.com | Loads but yields only fragments (role categories, city names) — no titles, companies, or links. Useless. | | Not tested (budget) | otta.com, wearedevelopers.com, honeypot.io, indeed.com, glassdoor.com | ## URL-parameter findings - **Path-based taxonomy beats query strings** on the two best boards. euremotejobs and himalayas both filter via URL *paths*, not params. - **Himalayas paths do not compose.** `/jobs/countries/italy` works and `/jobs/python` works, but `/jobs/countries/italy/skills/python` → **404**, as did `/jobs/countries/italy/skills/ai`. Pick one axis per request. - **RemoteRocketship's `country/` path is reliable** and `jobTitle=` does appear to bite — every result on `/country/italy?...&jobTitle=AI%20Engineer` had an AI/ML title (AI Product Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, AI Developer, CFD & Aerodynamic Engineer AI Training), though the page reported a generic "25 total jobs" count. `sort=DateAdded` and `page=` both work. - **Himalayas rate-limits.** `/jobs/ai-engineer` returned **429** on a first-ever hit while three other fetches ran concurrently. The skill should serialize Himalayas calls, not parallelize them. - Guessing slugs is expensive: 3 of my 24 calls were 404s from invented paths (`/job-region/europe-only/`, two himalayas composites). Hardcode only verified paths. ## Plain-text / JSON endpoints (3 tested) 1. `https://remoteok.com/api` — **works**, clean JSON, and the only way to get RemoteOK data at all. 2. `https://arbeitnow.com/api/job-board-api` — **works**, clean JSON. Response was truncated mid-object by the fetch length limit, so parse defensively; no pagination metadata in the body. 3. `https://weworkremotely.com/categories/remote-programming-jobs.rss` — **fails**, `[binary data]`. 4. (Bonus) `https://jobicy.com/api/v2/remote-jobs` — robots-disallowed. ## Top 5 recommended sources 1. **euremotejobs.com** — purpose-built for this exact candidate. Region paths distinguish "Europe only" from "Worldwide" from "EMEA", which is the single most important filter when you hold an EU permit and can't take US-only roles. Freshest feed I saw (listings 10-14 minutes old) and the most frequent salary disclosure. 2. **remoterocketship.com** — the only board that gave me real Italy-specific remote roles with EUR salaries and working keyword+country+sort composition in one URL. Claims 48% of its jobs aren't on LinkedIn. 3. **himalayas.app** — uniquely states the *region restriction* per job ("Netherlands only", "Global"), which kills the biggest time-waster: applying to US-only "remote" roles. 117 pages under Italy. Serialize the requests. 4. **arbeitnow.com API + remoteok.com API** — the two JSON endpoints. Use these for bulk/structured passes since they need no HTML parsing and expose epoch timestamps for date math. Arbeitnow covers DACH; RemoteOK covers global overflow. Both need heavy filtering (non-tech noise; RemoteOK salaries are unusable). 5. **aijobs.net** — best salary transparency of any board tested and strongly on-target for the AI/ML side of the brief. Downgraded only because I couldn't verify its filter params. Skip Wellfound unless the candidate will consider US-timezone roles — the listings load fine but skew heavily American. ## Freshness signals - **Absolute best:** euremotejobs and remoterocketship both show minute-level ages ("10 min ago", "0 min ago"); remoterocketship also shows absolute dates ("July 28", "April 2"). - **Sortable by recency via URL:** only `remoterocketship.com/?sort=DateAdded` was verified working. RemoteOK's HTML exposes a "Latest" sort control but its listings don't render. - **Programmatic date filtering:** only via the two JSON APIs — RemoteOK gives `date` (ISO, e.g. `2026-08-04`) plus `epoch`; arbeitnow gives `created_at` epoch. Filter to last 7/30 days client-side from those. - **No board tested exposed a verified "posted within N days" URL parameter.** Himalayas and aijobs.net show relative ages ("2 mins ago", "3h ago", "27 days ago") that you can parse from the page but not filter on server-side. - Himalayas listings ranged from "2 mins ago" to "27 days ago" on page 1 — its default ordering is not purely chronological, so stale results are interleaved. Check dates rather than trusting position.
